label: deepseek-v4-flash
_note: The distillation candidate under test. $0.14/$0.28 per Mtok against $9/$48 for the whole frontier panel, so a 43-arm battery costs about two cents per judge. Open weights, so it can be fine-tuned and quantised and then frozen, which is what a measuring instrument wants.

label: qwen3-32b
_note: Nearest open-weight peer by price ($0.08/$0.28) and a different lineage, so agreement between it and deepseek is evidence about the task rather than about one training corpus.

label: llama-3.3-70b
_note: Larger dense open-weight model at $0.10/$0.32. Included to separate 'this criterion needs a bigger model' from 'this criterion needs a better-suited one'.

label: glm-5
_note: Strongest open-weight tier in this slate at $0.95/$2.55, and the ceiling check: if a criterion fails here too, the failure is not about model size within the open-weight family.
